r: The **Rashtrakutas** – the Magallu record calls Gundaya and Eriya "Rashtrakuta"; the early emblem was **Garuda**
Feudatories of the **Kalyani (Western) Chalukyas** – emblem **Varaha** (changed by **Prola I**); title **Mahamandaleswara**, borne by Beta II
Samanta (feudatory) 956–1162 → **sovereign 1163–1323**; ruled Andhra in the **12th–13th centuries**
Rashtrakuta Krishna made Gundaya's son **Eriya** its head – a check on the **Mudigonda Chalukyas**; Eriya made **Orugallu (Kakatipuram)** his capital
Associated with the early **Kakatiyas**, with **Orugallu (Warangal)** on its border; **Eriya Rashtrakuta** ruled it from **Orugallu Kakatipuram**
The title **Kakatipuravallabha** (Bayyaram inscription period) links the clan name to Kakatipuram, likely after its **Kakatamma (Kakitamma) temple**
